_note: Food and non-alcoholic beverages during working hours at office or business premises are not salary "to the extent the value thereof … does not exceed" the limit per meal; the excess is (D-117). TY 2026-27: "₹200 per meal" (r.15(5) Table IV Sl. 3 col. D (a), Gazette 271092, p.1546). TY 2025-26: "fifty rupees per meal" (Rules 1962 r.3(7)(iii) first proviso, consolidated rule 3, p.4). Per meal: one entry per meal value, so meals do not average. Every regime.
